name: Cessna 408 SkyCourier
summary: Newest Cessna twin turboprop, a large, strut-braced utility airliner and freighter that Textron brought to market in the early 2020s.

wings: High, straight wing braced by a strut on each side
Large, plain wing with no winglets
engines: Two PT6A turboprops on the wing leading edge
fuselage: Large, boxy, slab-sided fuselage with a large cargo door on the left rear
Passenger version has a row of large windows; freighter has few windows
tail: T-tail with the tailplane on top of the fin

tellTales: Large strut-braced high-wing twin with fixed tricycle gear
Deep, slab-sided cargo fuselage with a large rear cargo door
T-tail on a high-wing twin with fixed tricycle gear

confusedWith.howToTell: The Caravan is a single and much smaller; the SkyCourier is a twin with a T-tail and a deeper, wider fuselage.
The Twin Otter has a conventional low tail and a long pointed nose; the SkyCourier has a T-tail, a deeper fuselage and a short blunt nose.
The 228 has a long pointed nose and no wing struts; the SkyCourier has wing struts and a blunter nose.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
